findings.issue: Lint: AC5 is new but no section 16 row covers it. TC-E5-005-05 is the access case, so AC5 is added to its description.
Size row says 'the squad sizes it at refinement'. That process claim is not in the item or the story sources.
Section 13 states empty and error behaviour (X5, platform error envelope) that section 15 and the item mark Not specified. The paragraph is contradictory and invented.
AC10 Gherkin invents retry and timeout behaviour, but the disposition and TC-E5-005-12 say the test is Not specified in the source documents.
AC11 Gherkin invents failed-call behaviour, but the disposition and TC-E5-005-13 say the test is Not specified in the source documents.
Decision ID D-RCV-60 is written into new scenario titles AC5 to AC12. Decision IDs must not appear in the story body.
